findings.description: ExecutionAdapter.apply retains its exact current return shape and escalation routing is defined as a separate retryable cleanup operation following durable application.
findings.resolution: D1 and D5 confirm that apply remains unchanged in signature and return shape, while route_parked_escalations operates separately after apply or from apply error cleanup.

findings.description: One workspace serialization boundary prevents concurrent duplicate decisions while a private already-locked resume helper avoids nested flock reentrancy deadlock.
findings.resolution: D2 specifies that route_parked_escalations holds the workspace lock and delegates to a private _resume_locked helper, preventing nested flock acquisition.

findings.description: escalate_resume decision subject identity is scoped to dispatch ID and lease_generation, ensuring same-generation retries reuse prior decisions without auto-resuming future exhaustions.
findings.resolution: D3 and spec scenarios ensure that prior-record identity includes lease_generation, preventing cross-generation decision reuse.

findings.description: Authorized resume clears the prior generation application journal and increments lease generation so that the resumed generation can apply a fresh result.
findings.resolution: D7 and task 1.6 verify that authorized resume clears application_journal and other terminal fields prior to launching the fresh generation.

findings.description: Blocked decisions synchronously project to the supervisor mirror, stale/missing handoffs rehydrate from mirror, and the next supervisor handoff retains the pending gate and deadline.
findings.resolution: D8, spec scenarios, and task 3.1 establish synchronous mirror projection, stale-handoff rehydration, and retention in subsequent handoffs.

findings.description: Routing outputs and notification context are exact, bounded, allowlisted, and contain no child transcripts, raw approval payloads, or child-provided reason text.
findings.resolution: D5 and contracts/README.md enforce strict bounding and substitute fixed policy-pause reason text into gate notification context.

findings.description: Partial-batch and post-route failures never replay apply or dispatch_fn, and already committed work is safely reported as already_routed without duplicate route effects.
findings.resolution: D1, D6, and spec scenarios prohibit apply replay on routing failure and ensure already committed proceeds report already_routed.

findings.description: Work-package scope, locks, and validation tasks comprehensively cover every stated requirement and enable full implementation and verification.
findings.resolution: work-packages.yaml and tasks.md define appropriate file locks, write scopes, unit/integration test suites, and strict OpenSpec validation steps.
